chapter: Looking back and the New York years
title: Arranging for Basie, Red Norvo and Teddy Powell
summary: Smith arranged for Basie in 1938, for Red Norvo and for Teddy Powell's band at the Famous Door.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: You were arranging for Basie -- this was in '38.

'38. Arranging for Basie and I was arranging... I wrote some arrangements for Red Norvo, and I did some arranging for Powell -- the last name; he had a big band down there in the Famous Door. I did some arranging for him.
No. He didn't play anything. He didn't do anything but just stood up in front and the band and direct.
Yeah. I think his name was Teddy Powell.
Now, that just lasted for six or seven months?
Oh, that lasted a long time. I wanted a raise(?)/to arrange(?). But it wasn't long before Basie went out of there and had to get on the road.
Did you go with him on the road?
